say: Shaida, tattalin arziki da jagorancin iri na al'umma.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na 3 na Haɓakar Noma da Inganta amfanin gona.
Gwajin ku ya gaya muku nawa sabon nau'in amfanin gona ya samu. Har yanzu bai gaya muku ko ya biya ba.

say: Rubuta dokokin yanke shawara kafin ku ga sakamakon. Misali, Hauwa a Kano ta karbo ne kawai idan iri-iri ya ci nasara a cikin duka ukun kuma dawowa ya wuce 100%.
Iri-iri A ya dace da kowace doka. Amma ta dasa shi a kan rabin ƙasarta, ba duka ba, domin kakar ɗaya ƙayyadaddun shaida ne.

panel.heading: Hukuncin Hauwa
left: Ya ci nasara a cikin duka tubalan 3

say: Bambancin B ya ci nasara akan matsakaici amma ba a kowane shinge ba, kuma dawowar sa shine kawai 45%. Ta sake gwada shi a kan ƙaramin yanki, kuma ta adana iri da ta saba a matsayin inshora.

panel.heading: Hukuncin Hauwa
left: Ya ci nasara a cikin duka tubalan 3

say: Rubuta gajeriyar rahoto mai gaskiya. Ba da burin ku da nau'ikan ku, hanyoyinku da tsarin ku, da bayanin kula kamar busassun lallausan dabbobi ko lalata.
Sanya sakamakon a cikin tebur tare da ingantaccen amfanin ƙasa, sannan ɓangaren kasafin kuɗin ku da shawarar ku. Fadi a sarari abin da bai yi aiki ba.

panel.heading: Abin da rahoton gwajin ku ya ƙunshi
items: Manufar da iri, tare da tushen iri
Hanyoyi: kwanan wata, tazara, shimfidawa
Bayanan yanayi: ruwan sama, kwari, lalacewa
Teburin sakamako tare da ingantattun kayan amfanin gona
Kasafin kudi na yanki da shawarar ku

say: Don tunawa. Wani ɓangare na kasafin kuɗi yana lissafin abin da ke canzawa kawai. Gwada ƙananan farashi da mummunan yanayi. Busasshen iri a duba shi tare da gwajin gishiri, sannan a adana shi ba tare da iska ba. Kuma saita dokokin ku kafin ganin sakamakon.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Jera kawai farashi da kudin shiga da ke canzawa
Karɓa-ko da riba = ƙarin farashi / farashi
Gwada ƙananan farashi da mummunan yanayi
bushe tare da gwajin gishiri; kantin sayar da iska
Saita dokokin yanke shawara kafin sakamako

say: Yanzu gina wani ɓangare na kasafin kuɗin ku tare da farashin gida, yi gwajin gilashin gishiri, da tsara dokokin bankin iri tare da leta. Sannan rubuta jigon rahoton ku da tsarin kwanan ku na kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gina kasafin kuɗin ku na ɗan lokaci
Yi gwajin kwalban gishiri kuma sanya iri
